task.title: Verify the installation
task.shortdesc: Start the service, run the health check, and prove the station works in simulation.

step.cmd: Log in at the station with a test operator account.
step.stepresult: The CCS window shows the classification banner and site ID.

step.cmd: Open SMOKE-AIR.plan, select Validate, then Launch (Sim).
step.stepresult: The simulated aircraft follows the route for 5 minutes with no errors.

step.cmd: Open SMOKE-UUV.plan, select Validate, then Launch (Sim).
step.stepresult: The simulated UUV completes the dive profile with no errors.

step.cmd: With ISSO approval, set ccs.datalink.mode=live and restart the service.
step.info: Do this only after every earlier step passes.
